title: Application for Working on Weekends & Holidays

subject.label: Subject
subject.why: Subject is 'Application for Working on <work date>, <writer name>' on all 10 own docs; the date is the WORK date (294429: drafted 2026-05-29, subject 2026-06-06), so it must equal view:Application date, which this schema cannot compare and the drafter must ensure.

reason.label: Reason
reason.why: Reason is a one-sentence English description of the research work (memory example 'Nextflow based urban metagenomic surveillance pipeline optimization'), not a time range like the AppFrm-027 script's 'Overtime work: 17:20 - 20:20'; min 20 only rejects an empty/placeholder reason (shortest own value 53, n=10), no max because no colleague docs.

app_dt[].label: Application date
app_dt[].why: The day of the overtime/holiday work; a fact of the case.

working_time[].label: Expected Working hours
working_time[].why: The amount is per case, but the form's printed rules (on all 10 docs) require more than 1 hour and cap total overtime at 12 h per week, so a single entry must be HH:MM between 01:00 and 12:00; all 10 own values were whole hours 02:00-07:00.

view:Actual Working hours Start.label: Actual Working hours Start
view:Actual Working hours Start.why: Filled from the clock-in/out system after the work; a case fact.

view:Actual Working hours End.label: Actual Working hours End
view:Actual Working hours End.why: Filled from the clock-in/out system after the work; a case fact.

view:Times.label: Times
view:Times.why: Computed actual overtime, capped at the pre-approved hours (294429: 05:05 worked, 05:00 counted).
